key_insight: An interactive visual analytics framework links evolving cancer care team collaboration patterns with model-estimated patient outcome risk, without implying causation.
clinical_relevance: The framework may help analysts explore how care team composition and specialist participation relate to changing risk estimates across cancer treatment stages.
method: Build dynamic care team networks from EHR-mediated communications.
Estimate outcome risk over time using a temporal graph neural network.
Combine network visualizations, surrogate logistic regression explanations, and exploratory what-if analysis.
evidence_signal: Expert-guided analysis scenarios involved 505 patients with breast, colorectal, and lung cancers; the abstract reports no quantitative predictive performance.
watch_item: Observed associations and what-if outputs do not establish that changing care team composition would improve survival.
paper_title: Visualizing and Interpreting Temporal Care Team Dynamics for Cancer Survival Risk Analysis
